question: How many records of each kind does the evidence hold?
english: The evidence holds exactly 1 search-box record: the text "secret" typed into the Windows Explorer search box (2015-03-23 18:40:17 UTC). This counts records in the evidence file. An event that left no record, or a record the extractor does not read, is not counted.

prov.time_meaning: registry key last-write time: the moment the most recent search (recency_rank 1) was typed; older entries were typed at or before it
